DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_MonochromeQueen:
Joy and misery come in equal measure for <characterName id=|MonochromeQueen|/>. 
Those who choose to take care of one must be prepared for what that entails.

Bottles its misery into <itemName id=|Bio_Coolant| style=|Status_Keyword|/>, saving only its joy for its tamer while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_MonochromeQueen:
While in party, 
increases the player's Attack by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> if all Pals in party are different species. 
(Does not stack)

Bottles its misery into <itemName id=|Bio_Coolant| style=|Status_Keyword|/>, saving only its joy for its tamer while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
